entry_points.text: Compressed entries cover 32 and 64 bit; 32 bit relocates stack and checks paging; 64 bit sets PAE, MCE and LA57, trampoline and paging then jumps.
Real mode setup runs probes then transfer; memory and disk discovery, CPU validation, protected switch and low jump are entries.
Encryption probe halts on mismatch; page fault maps enclosing large page; extract sets console, validates, accepts, decompresses and returns base.
Fatal die pairs with oops end and unwind to per CPU top then kill; IP, IRET, register and opcode views are diagnostic entries.
Display entry probes cards and resolves mode with retry; early VC handler serves CPUID exits during startup.

exports.text: A20 reports zero on success else negative; APM queries caps with verify cycle; prep clears carry and copies registers.
Segment helpers load store compare small widths; bit test uses mask or hardware op; option fetch joins halves; panic formats then halts.
EFI tables resolved by bitness with kexec walk; RSDP via params, EFI or BIOS scan; SRAT picked and non-hotplug regions counted.
Identity maps cover image, params, cmdline and firmware; SNP toggles privacy; accept dispatches to guests.
KASLR bounds, avoids, then picks phys and virt updating only on success; copies handle overlap; CPU check gates boot.
Diagnostics show registers and classify stacks; unwind advances iterators; early services load GDT and IDT, encrypt in place, expose EFI entries.

hazards.text: Controller drain uses bounded loops with missing escape; fast gate sequences low bits; TDX collapse and unknown exits terminate.
Map splits preserve order with flush; OOM leaves unchanged; faults log then abort; SEV mismatch halts; KASLR full aborts.
Terminate exits via channel then halts forever; bad magic, tables, secrets or failed negotiation abort; affected Phi without PAE refused.
MBR probing fails safe; BIOS may hang and map loss discards all; transition needs aligned GDT and null IDT; oops tolerates nesting.
Bad frames warn once with dump then suppress; video prompt retries indefinitely and can stall on dead clock or bad input.

invariants.text: A20 alias compares 1M views with save and restore; heap bumps aligned with reset and no free; stack fixed with pause.
Valued options parse after equals with caps; flags 1-based; integers infer radix and split overflow and invalid; printf flags, width and bases.
Flags collected once with ID probe; level promotes on flags and long mode; vendor from words; accept needs level, caps and no erratum.
Page alloc bumps with full refusal; mask covers bits; top excludes encryption; relocation applies delta; ELF staged then entry returned.
Guest type cached from leaves and bits; caps need range plus feature; enable derives mask; accept privatizes; disabled is no-op.
Overlap unless one precedes other; memmap reserves and limits; handover then firmware then RAM; gaps emitted past overlaps; choice uniform.
Console fans to serial and video with bounded poll and scroll; early serial sets divisor; trampoline scans high to low for RAM.
Blob prefers EFI then setup chain with magic check; decode bounded; IDT moves GHCB-only to full to off; ORC searches kernel then modules.

locks.text: SVSM 4K request saves IRQs across MSR call and restores; early NMI only bumps counter without synchronization.
Oops begin saves IRQs and takes die lock with nested same CPU path; table stepping holds scoped read guard.

state_machines.text: A20 tries firmware short, controller long, delayed then fast long; stops on success; fast path resets low bits.
Page and MSR order validate around update with retry; IDT GHCB-only to full to off; paging enabled if allowed.
Setup runs IO, params, console, heap, CPU, probes, video then transfer; E820 loops; disk scans from fixed base; CPU baseline to screened.
Protected switch runs hook, gate, masks, tables and jump; low jump preloads selectors; firmware handover maps identity and far jumps.
Oops end clears state, releases lock at zero nesting, then returns, panics or rewinds; mode maps aliases and persists id.

structs.text: Register block unions full, halves and bytes; CPU holds level, family, model and caps; port ops abstract IO; GDT uses packed bound plus address.
EFI header, memory, config and system tables sized by bitness with GUID plus address entries, stride iteration and page shift 12.
A20 retry and drain bounds, BIOS window low memory, KASLR avoid plus slots capped, link page aligned with zero GOT.
Serial defaults COM1 with fixed offsets and DLAB; format flags are powers of two; SNP masks group features; blob carries magic.
